goal: Clarify the actual underlying storage path in debug logs when the data directory uses symlinks.
Helps developers and node operators verify which physical drive or directory was used during a run.
agreement: No overall stance expressed yet on the change itself.
Suggested avoiding redundant log lines when paths are identical (l0rinc)
Suggested printing the resolved path on the existing datadir log line, which the author adopted (sedited)

categories.name: utils
why: P4 because it is a minor logging convenience when inspecting runs on symlinked storage paths.
Has no operational impact on node behavior beyond clarifying saved log diagnostics.
